name: antigravity-app
description: Google Antigravity Dual-Engine App (Gemini Web Home + Antigravity Code Remote) with Claude Code Remote Bottom Sheets

scripts.build:inject: bun build src/inject/agy-bridge.ts --format=iife --target=browser --outfile=src/generated/agy-bridge.iife.js && bun build src/inject/gemini-bridge.ts --format=iife --target=browser --outfile=src/generated/gemini-bridge.iife.js && cp src/generated/agy-bridge.iife.js src/generated/gemini-bridge.iife.js src-tauri/gen/android/app/src/main/assets/
scripts.build: bun run build:inject && tsc --noEmit && vite build
